record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> that came to Jeremiah<WH03414> from the LORD<WH03068>, after<WH0310> that Nebuzaradan<WH05018> the captain<WH07227> of the guard<WH02876> had let him go<WH07971><WTH8763> from Ramah<WH07414>, when he had taken<WH03947><WTH8800> him being bound<WH0631><WTH8803> in chains<WH0246> among<WH08432> all that were carried away captive<WH01546> of Jerusalem<WH03389> and Judah<WH03063>, which were carried away captive<WH01540><WTH8716> unto Babylon<WH0894>. <RF>chains: or, manicles<Rf>

And now, behold, I loose<WH06605><WTH8765> thee this day<WH03117> from the chains<WH0246> which <FI>were<Fi> upon thine hand<WH03027>. If it seem good<WH02896><WH05869> unto thee to come<WH0935><WTH8800> with me into Babylon<WH0894>, come<WH0935><WTH8798>; and I will look well<WH07760><WTH8799><WH05869> unto thee: but if it seem ill<WH07489><WTH8804><WH05869> unto thee to come<WH0935><WTH8800> with me into Babylon<WH0894>, forbear<WH02308><WTH8798>: behold<WH07200><WTH8798>, all the land<WH0776> <FI>is<Fi>  before<WH06440> thee: whither it seemeth<WH0413> good<WH02896> and convenient<WH03477><WH05869> for thee to go<WH03212><WTH8800>, thither go<WH03212><WTH8798>. <RF>were...: or, are upon thine hand<Rf> <RF>I will...: Heb. I will set mine eye upon thee<Rf>

Now while he was not yet gone back<WH07725><WTH8799>, <FI>he said<Fi> , Go back<WH07725><WTH8798> also to Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Ahikam<WH0296> the son<WH01121> of Shaphan<WH08227>, whom the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> hath made governor<WH06485><WTH8689> over the cities<WH05892> of Judah<WH03063>, and dwell<WH03427><WTH8798> with him among<WH08432> the people<WH05971>: or go<WH03212><WTH8798> wheresoever it seemeth convenient<WH03477><WH05869> unto thee to go<WH03212><WTH8800>. Then went<WH0935><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414> unto Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Ahikam<WH0296> to Mizpah<WH04708>; and dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> with him among<WH08432> the people<WH05971> that were left<WH07604><WTH8737> in the land<WH0776>.<CM>

Now when all the captains<WH08269> of the forces<WH02428> which <FI>were<Fi> in the fields<WH07704>, <FI>even<Fi> they and their men<WH0582>, heard<WH08085><WTH8799> that the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> had made Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Ahikam<WH0296> governor<WH06485><WTH8689> in the land<WH0776>, and had committed<WH06485><WTH8689> unto him men<WH0582>, and women<WH0802>, and children<WH02945>, and of the poor<WH01803> of the land<WH0776>, of them that were not carried away captive<WH01540><WTH8717> to Babylon<WH0894>;

Then they came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Gedaliah<WH01436> to Mizpah<WH04708>, even Ishmael<WH03458> the son<WH01121> of Nethaniah<WH05418>, and Johanan<WH03110> and Jonathan<WH03129> the sons<WH01121> of Kareah<WH07143>, and Seraiah<WH08304> the son<WH01121> of Tanhumeth<WH08576>, and the sons<WH01121> of Ephai<WH05778> the Netophathite<WH05200>, and Jezaniah<WH03153> the son<WH01121> of a Maachathite<WH04602>, they and their men<WH0582>.

And Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Ahikam<WH0296> the son<WH01121> of Shaphan<WH08227> sware<WH07650><WTH8735> unto them and to their men<WH0582>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Fear<WH03372><WTH8799> not to serve<WH05647><WTH8800> the Chaldeans<WH03778>: dwell in<WH03427><WTH8798> the land<WH0776>, and serve<WH05647><WTH8798> the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>, and it shall be well<WH03190><WTH8799> with you.

As for me, behold, I will dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> at Mizpah<WH04709> to serve<WH05975><WTH8800><WH06440> the Chaldeans<WH03778>, which will come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto us: but ye, gather<WH0622><WTH8798> ye wine<WH03196>, and summer fruits<WH07019>, and oil<WH08081>, and put<WH07760><WTH8798> <FI>them<Fi> in your vessels<WH03627>, and dwell<WH03427><WTH8798> in your cities<WH05892> that ye have taken<WH08610><WTH8804>. <RF>to serve: Heb. to stand before<Rf>

Likewise when all the Jews<WH03064> that <FI>were<Fi> in Moab<WH04124>, and among the Ammonites<WH05983>, and in Edom<WH0123>, and that <FI>were<Fi> in all the countries<WH0776>, heard<WH08085><WTH8804> that the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> had left<WH05414><WTH8804> a remnant<WH07611> of Judah<WH03063>, and that he had set<WH06485><WTH8689> over them Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Ahikam<WH0296> the son<WH01121> of Shaphan<WH08227>;

Even all the Jews<WH03064> returned out<WH07725><WTH8799> of all places<WH04725> whither they were driven<WH05080><WTH8738>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> to the land<WH0776> of Judah<WH03063>, to Gedaliah<WH01436>, unto Mizpah<WH04708>, and gathered<WH0622><WTH8799> wine<WH03196> and summer fruits<WH07019> very<WH03966> much<WH07235><WTH8687>.

Moreover Johanan<WH03110> the son<WH01121> of Kareah<WH07143>, and all the captains<WH08269> of the forces<WH02428> that <FI>were<Fi> in the fields<WH07704>, came<WH0935><WTH8804> to Gedaliah<WH01436> to Mizpah<WH04708>,

But Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Ahikam<WH0296> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Johanan<WH03110> the son<WH01121> of Kareah<WH07143>, Thou shalt not do<WH06213><WTH8799> this thing<WH01697>: for thou speakest<WH01696><WTH8802> falsely<WH08267> of Ishmael<WH03458>.<CM>
